rawResults.Snippet: In Azure AI Search, semantic ranker is a feature that measurably improves search relevance by using Microsoft's language understanding models to rerank search results. Semantic ranker is also built into agentic retrieval. This article is a high-level introduction to help you understand the behaviors and benefits of semantic ranker.

rawResults.Snippet: 4 days agoSemantic ranking iterates over an initial result set, applying an L2 ranking methodology that promotes the most semantically relevant results to the top of the stack.
